title: ACCORD 12
text: Someone has put a picture of the empty berth on Ash on the wall by the Core. Under it, in chalk: ACCORD 12. Nobody has rubbed it off. {who} stands in front of it every morning before shift.

choices.label: Leave it up
choices.reply: It stays. By the end of the week there are thirty-two marks chalked under it, one for every other hull. Nobody owns up to them.

choices.label: Ask {who} about it
choices.reply: "I like to know where I'm parked," {who} says, and goes to work.

notes: A colonist at home reacts by name once hull-field is done (the discovery played back at home, v0.90.0).
